main.description: The invitation is kept in the organization's space where its PDS has spaces, else in its public records. Invited again, an invitation that lapsed starts over.

first.description: Whether this made the account an organization.

had.description: The role they had before, if they had one.

org.description: The organization's handle, or its DID when none resolves back to it.

private.description: Whether the invitation is in the organization's space, which only it and its members read; else in its public records.

was.description: Where they stood before: invited, lapsed (invited over 7 days ago), or a public or hidden member. Absent when they were not invited.

who.description: The invitee's handle, or their DID when none resolves back to it.

description: Invites an account to an organization, or changes a member's role, through the gateway the organization delegated writes to, which writes as the organization. The caller must be an admin of it who joined. Requires a service token from the caller's PDS, audience the gateway's DID, for this method.
